title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Raw‑sounding soundboard captures a high‑energy set highlighted by a stellar Love Light and Pigpen‑driven jams.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a gritty, almost live‑room vibe that many fans describe as “better than ever,” preserving the raw power of the performance. Highlights include an especially great rendition of "Love Light" and Pigpen’s incendiary presence that fuels the jam-heavy first set. Overall the show is praised for its intensity despite the lack of polished studio polish.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and consistently mention strong performance and decent sound quality, leading to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the raw, MIT‑steps‑like ambience but also comment that the sound is clearer than previous circulations and generally pleasant to listen to.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy jams with Pigpen’s fiery vocals drive a loose, raw feel throughout the set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's vocal and organ fire is highlighted as a major driver of the show’s intensity.
